verdict.rationale: Twenty docs mention enrichment as a workflow example ("Auto-enrich new contacts with data from external APIs") and as an AI-agent capability ("Enrich records with data from external sources"), but this is achieved by building a custom workflow/HTTP-request/AI-agent step against an external API rather than a native, built-in firmographic/contact data provider integration. missing for 10: a first-party enrichment data source/partner integration, evidence of actual firmographic field population, independent/hands-on confirmation that this works in practice.
